display.purpose: Hero headline only. Fraunces semibold, tight leading.

title.purpose: Card titles and the editor label. Fraunces semibold.

body.purpose: All prose and the editor text. DM Sans, relaxed leading, ~65ch max.

label.purpose: Rare uppercase tracked labels: hero kicker and Revised-text tag only.

shadows.name: resting
shadows.purpose: Default for cards and the editor; surfaces rest nearly flat.

motion.name: fade-up
motion.purpose: First-load entrance for hero elements; staggered via 100-300ms delays; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover/focus state changes on buttons and cards.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main CTA (Analyze / Sign in to analyze). Inkwell Teal, white text, 12px radius.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary actions (Sign out, Clear results). Transparent, fills with Aged Paper on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.7); font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease-out, color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f0ebe3; color: #1c1917; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(13, 92, 99, 0.2); }

components.name: Bordered Utility Button
components.description: The Paste button: ghost with a hairline border on a translucent Aged Paper fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-utility { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: rgba(240, 235, 227, 0.5); color: #1c1917; font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(224, 216, 204, 0.8); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-utility:hover { background: rgba(224, 216, 204, 0.5); } .ds-btn-utility:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(13, 92, 99, 0.2); }

components.name: Editor Card
components.description: The centerpiece container holding the draft editor. Translucent paper, hairline border, resting shadow.
components.html:
Your draft

Paste or write here and get corrections with explanations.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(250, 248, 245, 0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(224, 216, 204, 0.8); border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1c1917; display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.625; color: rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.7); margin: 0; }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: Marketing feature card: 16px radius, teal-tinted icon well, gentle hover lift.
components.html:
Instant Proofreading

Get corrections with context—not just a red underline.
components.css: .ds-feature { background: rgba(250, 248, 245, 0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(224, 216, 204, 0.8); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transition: transform 300ms ease-out, border-color 300ms ease-out, box-shadow 300ms ease-out; } .ds-feature:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: rgba(13, 92, 99, 0.3); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-feature-icon { display: inline-flex; background: rgba(13, 92, 99, 0.1); color: #0d5c63; padding: 12px; border-radius: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-feature-title { font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; color: #1c1917; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-feature-text { font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.625; color: rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.7); margin: 0; }

components.name: Draft Textarea
components.description: The product's centerpiece input. Teal focus ring, example-sentence placeholder.
components.html: <textarea class="ds-textarea" rows="4" placeholder="Paste or write here. Example: “I has went to the market yesterday.”"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-textarea { width: 100%; background: #faf8f5; color: #1c1917; font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.625; padding: 12px 16px; border: 1px solid #e0d8cc; border-radius: 12px; resize: vertical; transition: border-color 200ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms ease-out; } .ds-textarea::placeholder { color: rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.35); } .ds-textarea:focus { outline: none; border-color: #0d5c63; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(13, 92, 99, 0.2); }

components.name: Result Panel
components.description: The tutor's margin note: Aged Paper well presenting the revised text under a small teal label.
components.html:
Revised text

I went to the market yesterday and bought some apples—they were fresh.
components.css: .ds-result { background: rgba(240, 235, 227, 0.5); border: 1px solid rgba(13, 92, 99, 0.15); border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; text-align: left; } .ds-result-label { font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #0d5c63; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-result-body { font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.625; color: #1c1917; margin: 0; white-space: pre-wrap; }

components.name: Header
components.description: Fixed translucent header: Fraunces wordmark left, session state right.
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; background: rgba(250, 248, 245, 0.85); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(224, 216, 204, 0.7); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-header-brand { font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: #1c1917; text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-header-brand:hover { color: #0d5c63; } .ds-header-action { background: transparent; color: rgba(28, 25, 23, 0.7); font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms ease-out; } .ds-header-action:hover { background: #f0ebe3; }

components.name: Error Callout
components.description: Soft error surface: Quiet Crimson at 5% alpha with 30%-alpha border. The No Red Pen Rule in practice.
components.html: Can’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
components.css: .ds-error { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; background: rgba(153, 27, 27, 0.05); border: 1px solid rgba(153, 27, 27, 0.3); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; color: #991b1b; font-family: 'DM Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-error svg { flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 1px; }

narrative.overview: QuickRefine looks and feels like a patient teacher's warm workspace: good paper, a calm teal pen, and notes in the margin that explain rather than grade. The body surface is warm paper washed by faint teal and bronze radial gradients so the page feels like a lit desk, not a white void. The single tool at the center — the draft editor — is the most important object on the desk, and every other section supports it. The system's density is crisp and studious: precise stationery rather than plush furniture, with a serif voice (Fraunces) for anything the tutor says and a plain, highly legible sans (DM Sans) for everything the student reads and writes.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground with atmospheric teal/bronze washes; never flat white, never dark mode.
Deep, ink-like accents at low saturation-noise: one teal voice, used sparingly and confidently.
Serif display (Fraunces) for voice, sans (DM Sans) for reading and writing surfaces.
Soft-ambient depth: surfaces rest nearly flat; shadows whisper on hover.
Corrections presented as guidance, never as grading.

rules.name: The One Pen Rule
rules.body: Inkwell Teal is the only color allowed to ask for a click. If two teal elements compete in one view, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The No Red Pen Rule
rules.body: Errors and corrections are never presented with harsh solid red. Quiet Crimson appears only on soft tinted surfaces with plain-language explanation beside it. A correction is a margin note, not a grade.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Fraunces speaks (headings, labels of substance); DM Sans reads and writes (prose, inputs, buttons, UI). No third font, ever.

rules.name: The Calm Desk Rule
rules.body: Shadows communicate response, not hierarchy. If an element needs to look important at rest, use the border, the surface tint, or Inkwell Teal — never a bigger shadow.

dos: Do keep Writing Paper (#faf8f5) as the ground everywhere; the atmospheric teal/bronze wash stays behind content at the body level.
Do reserve Inkwell Teal for interaction and emphasis — The One Pen Rule. Tint fills at 10-20% alpha; full strength only on primary actions and key labels.
Do set all reading and writing surfaces in DM Sans at ≥1rem with relaxed leading; this audience reads English as a second language.
Do keep body text at ≥4.5:1 contrast — Reading Ink at 65% alpha on Writing Paper is the floor for secondary text; captions at 45-50% alpha are for non-essential metadata only.
Do give every interactive element a visible focus ring (2px, Inkwell Teal at 20% alpha) and every animation a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
Do keep motion at 150-300ms ease-out, state-driven: hover lifts, loading dots, fade-up entrances on first load only.
donts: Don't drift toward Grammarly-style SaaS: no mascots, no upsell banners, no feature-matrix marketing, no freemium nagging.
Don't touch the sterile AI-tool template: no dark gradient heroes, no glassmorphism-as-decoration, no sparkle emoji, no powered-by-GPT genericism.
Don't grade like academic test-prep: no solid red-pen corrections, no scores or percentages, no exam-pressure framing — The No Red Pen Rule.
Don't gamify: no streaks, badges, or cartoon mascots; QuickRefine must be taken seriously by serious learners.
Don't add a third font family, use pure black (#000) or clinical white (#fff) surfaces, or introduce cool grays into the warm neutral ramp.
Don't use colored side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px) on callouts or results — the soft tinted-surface-plus-full-border pattern is the house style.
Don't put uppercase tracked labels above every section; they are reserved for the hero kicker and the Revised-text tag.
